blocks.text: The search for the next Bond girl has put South Korean actor Jung Ho-yeon in the spotlight, with Vogue highlighting her as a standout choice for the upcoming 007 film. The US fashion magazine has ranked Jung fifth on its list of 45 actors it considers good picks for the role, news reports said Wednesday.
